meta_description: SSL Decorators in Leicester offer interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and decorative finishes. Free quotes, reliable service. Call 07821 175159.
hero_eyebrow: Experienced Painter & Decorator — Leicester & Surrounding Areas
hero_subhead: Interior and exterior painting done right. Free quotes, no hidden costs, work you'll love.
services_subhead: From a fresh coat of paint to complete room transformations, we handle interior and exterior projects with care and precision.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: Walls, ceilings, woodwork, and feature walls. We prep surfaces properly and use premium paint for a finish that lasts. Modern or period properties — we know how to get it right.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weatherproof masonry, uPVC, and timber cladding. We work around the seasons and protect your garden. Your home will look fresh and last longer.

services.title: Wallpapering
services.desc: Contemporary patterns, textured finishes, or classic designs. We hang wallpaper straight and true, with no bubbles or seams showing. Perfect for feature walls or whole rooms.

services.title: Woodwork & Skirting
services.desc: Doors, skirting boards, window frames, and fitted furniture. We sand, prime, and finish with care. Crisp, durable results that frame your rooms beautifully.

services.title: Decorative Finishes
services.desc: Faux effects, textured coatings, and specialist paints. Create character and depth in any room. We can advise on colours and techniques that suit your home.

services.title: Commercial Decorating
services.desc: Office spaces, retail units, and rental properties. Quick turnaround, minimal disruption, professional standards. We work evenings and weekends to fit your schedule.

about_pullquote: Good decoration shouldn't cost the earth or take forever. That's the SSL way.
about_para_1: SSL Decorators has been transforming homes and businesses across Leicester for over 12 years. We started because we saw too many customers let down by unreliable decorators. Today, we've built a reputation on showing up on time, doing the job properly, and leaving your space looking brilliant.
about_para_2: Our customers trust us because we listen to what you want, give you a clear price upfront, and deliver without fuss. Repeat business and personal recommendations mean we're doing something right. Whether it's a single bedroom or a whole-house refresh, we bring the same care and attention to every job.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had the lounge and hallway redecorated. The team were tidy, professional, and finished on time. Colour advice was spot on. Really pleased with the result. Would recommend.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Brilliant service. They came round, gave a fair quote, and got the job done quickly without any mess. The walls are smooth and the skirting looks perfect. Couldn't ask for better.
reviews.author: Jennifer H.

reviews.text: Exterior of the house needed doing after years of neglect. Took a while but they did a thorough job. Prep work was careful and the finish is excellent. Very reasonable price too.
reviews.author: David M.
